name: @playliquid/game-ui
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Game Studio foundation (PL-033). Pure read-model projections of the authoritative public contracts (package-system records/gates, runtime-core session results, tool-fabric-runtime job snapshots, avatar-runtime definitions, capability-broker policy/grants) into typed UI view models (E5), a one-owner StudioStore, presentational React components with zero data fetching, and the web mount composition (packages/web/gameos). The runtime-contracts protocol layer is declared directly and deliberately: read models carry its branded primitives, and UI consumes authoritative contracts (module-dependency-matrix game-ui row; recorded in the work order report). Peer-react: the host web app provides React (same convention as the workspace web package). No IO, no timers, no fetch in this package; every datum arrives through ports.
